g.text: Browse and search (REQ-005-2/3/4)
Anyone, logged in or not, opens the home page
or the address of a region's jobs
A region's address?
yes
no, the home page
Not found
no
A region with that address exists,
active or hidden?
yes
A hidden region still opens by its address.
It is not among the region choices,
so no choice is marked.
List = Published listings of that region.
Heading names the region, so rows show
business and area only
List = Published listings of every region,
hidden regions included.
Rows show business, area and region
Only Published listings are ever on a list
(REQ-005-1): never a Draft, a Pending approval,
a Rejected, a Closed or a Taken down one. Logging in changes nothing.
Offer the region choices: "All regions" first,
then every active region in alphabetical order.
A region with no jobs is still offered
Under the list, always, also when it is empty:
"Every listing shows salary and is checked
by jairojobs before it is published."
Keep only listings where every word is found
in the title, business name, area, About the job,
Requirements or Benefits, ignoring capitals
Search and type work inside the list being
shown: one region, or all regions.
They are part of the address, so the
result can be shared, or reopened with
the words and the type filled in.
An empty search is no search.
Words beyond 100 characters are cut.
Keep only listings of the chosen type, if one is chosen
yes
Search words or a type in the address?
no
yes
Was a search or type applied?
"No jobs match your search."
and a way to clear the search
yes
A region's list?
no
"No jobs are listed in <region> yet."
and a link to all regions
"No jobs are listed yet."
no
Any listings left?
yes
Say how many jobs matched, and "newest first":
"38 jobs in Davao City · newest first"
("1 job" for one)
The order never changes: an Admin's edit
does not move a listing, and a search
keeps newest first.
Show the first 20 rows, newest approval first.
Each row: title, business and area (and region on
the all-regions list), salary range, posted date,
"✓ Approved". The whole row is the link
Offer "Show more" — 20 more each time
yes
More than 20?
no
Visitor chooses a region, searches,
chooses a type or clears?
yes
taps a row
Show that list. Choosing a region keeps
the search words and the type
